summary: Verified two bug fixes in Aviation Cognitive Aptitude app. Bug 1 (Cognitive Updating 6-panel layout) and Bug 2 (System Logic randomization) both FIXED. Also verified admin settings persistence, dashboard module gating, and SL end-to-end results screen.
critical_code_review_comments: CognitiveUpdating.js: askNextQuestion() and startInstructionPhase() read aircraftData from closure inside setInterval callbacks, potentially operating on stale data. Consider using functional setState or refs. Functional impact appears limited but could cause slight staleness in generated questions/instructions.
CognitiveUpdating.js line 108: maxInstructions - minInstructions can be 0 when questionCount is 0, causing NaN from Math.floor(Math.random()*0 + minInstructions) is safe but edge case exists.
SystemLogic.js: toggleTab counts every click (open AND close) as a tab-open in tabOpenCount which may inflate the count metric shown to user; consider counting only opens.
storage.js: getSettings() returns DEFAULT_SETTINGS reference directly (not a clone) when storage is empty — mutations to returned object would poison default. Low risk but not ideal.
seed_data_creation: Via admin UI: temporarily set sl-easy-questions=3, cu-easy-questions=2, cu-easy-delay=2 for faster test cycles (persisted to localStorage; user's browser may retain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: (1) CU now renders all 6 panels A-F simultaneously — closed panels display '[ CLOSED ]' placeholder with blue header; open panels have green header showing ALT/HDG/FUEL/SPD/FREQ/WPT. Panel toggle correctly closes the oldest open panel when a 3rd is clicked (verified visually: A+B initially, click C -> A closes, click D -> B closes). Red instruction banner and history populate. (2) SystemLogic askNextQuestion() calls generateSystemData() each question — questions were 3/3 unique across 3 consecutive attempts. 14+ question templates exist in generateSystemQuestion(). Results screen shows Accuracy, Average Response Time, Total Tab Opens, Unnecessary Opens as required. Dashboard: only cognitive-updating and system-logic cards enabled; other 10 disabled with 'Module locked' text. Admin: all 30 inputs (2 modules x 3 difficulties x 5/4 fields) present with correct data-testids; save-settings-btn persists to localStorage across reload.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only run; both prior bugs remain fixed.
